Solidigm, the U.S. subsidiary of SK Hynix
, is in discussions with the U.S. Commerce Dept. about investing $45B in a new chip plant in the country, Bloomberg reported, citing people familiar with the matter.

One of the conditions for Solidigm to invest in the plant is that it wants the Trump administration's permission to send equipment to China to upgrade an existing plant in the country, the news outlet added, citing its sources.
Solidigm and SK Hynix did not immediately respond to a request for comment from Seeking Alpha.

title: Solidigm talking to Commerce Dept. about investing $45B in new chip plant: report
